commits.message: fix(daemon): a boot the close ends gets its grace beside the teardown, and the renderer's end is a named teardown step (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

fix(daemon): the renderer the close waits on is still pinged, its end in the close is logged, and the teardown is bracketed so the renderer always ends (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

An in-process flush that fails is logged and the close still ends, as the process renderer's does.

fix(daemon): the close holds the renderer through its teardown, starts none, and flushes the session state as the renderer ends (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.w8l)

The renderer link learned of the close only in its last step, so a
renderer that ended mid-close was restarted and the close's remaining
asks queued behind a fresh boot. The link's close now spans the
teardown: a live renderer keeps serving, its end starts nothing, a boot
under way ends at once. The host's close-session-state ask is gone; the
renderer's own end flushes the session state, as it does on every other
way out.
